description: This PHP source file defines a controller class 'StatsAdminController' within the Goteo project. It handles administrative statistics-related routes, views, and data filtering functionalities for the admin interface, including route definitions, sidebar menu items, and view rendering for statistics pages.

classes.name: StatsAdminController
classes.description: Controller class responsible for handling admin statistics routes, views, and actions within the Goteo platform, including index and subviews, route definitions, and sidebar menu configuration.

methods.name: getRoutes
methods.description: Returns an array of Route objects defining URLs and their corresponding controller actions for the admin stats section.

methods.name: getSidebar
methods.description: Returns an array representing the sidebar menu items for the statistics section in the admin dashboard.

methods.name: indexAction
methods.description: Handles the default index action for the stats admin section, delegating to subAction with default parameters.

methods.name: subAction
methods.description: Handles rendering of sub-pages within the stats section, applying filters from request parameters, selecting templates, and preparing data for view rendering.
